title.narrative: The Labour Market Information and Analysis System is strengthened through technical support for producers and users

description.narrative: Strengthening the production and dissemination of labour statistics in line with international standards remains a key priority for evidence-based policymaking in Egypt. The Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS) faces the need to further align its statistical systems with the latest resolutions of the International Conference of Labour Statisticians (ICLS), including improved measurement of informality and emerging forms of work. During the biennium, the intervention is expected to enhance the methodological framework, data collection tools, and analytical capacity of CAPMAS to produce high-quality, internationally comparable labour statistics. Particular attention will be given to integrating modules on informality, labour migration and digital platform work, as well as strengthening data dissemination practices to support policy design and monitoring. The primary beneficiaries are national statistical authorities and government institutions responsible for labour market and migration policies. Indirect beneficiaries include workers, employers, and researchers who rely on accurate and timely labour market information, particularly in relation to emerging forms of employment and mobility patterns. The strategy is implemented in collaboration with United Nations agencies, multilateral development organizations, and relevant statistical bodies. It combines technical assistance, capacity building, and methodological support, as well as knowledge exchange on the application of ICLS standards and the measurement of new labour market dynamics, including digital platform work and migration.
